issues.detail: The instruction bytes support an equality skip followed by four sequential dword load/store pairs. The candidate preserves partial-overlap propagation, unaligned access, the exact 16-byte footprint and the normalized destination return.

The instruction bytes support an equality skip followed by six sequential dword load/store pairs. The candidate preserves partial-overlap propagation, unaligned access, the exact 24-byte footprint and the normalized destination return.

The candidate matches the low-byte enabled test, logical index shift, masked unsigned bit shift, four-byte read/modify/write and full EAX return of index >> 5. Contract bounds prevent address overflow; high index values requiring storage outside the arena are excluded.

The previous provenance gaps are resolved by the supplied raw/canonical hash domains, verified artifact bindings, compiler commands, ABI adapters and successful build/demo records. Public and held-out results total 742 passing cases; the overlap mutant produces 12 mismatches. These results corroborate the instruction-level review.

limitations: Text-only review; hashes, binary extraction and execution records were not independently recomputed. Function identities are tied to the supplied module SHA-256, RVAs and recorded slice hashes; LLVM symbol labels do not establish original names.
Recorded execution used AppleClang 21 on macOS arm64 and Unicorn 2.1.4 for original x86 slices. There is no native Windows x86 validation or tested replacement x86 ABI bridge.

The original adapter maps arguments and checks stack cleanup, preserved registers, DF, slice containment and footprints. The candidate adapter observes the complete u32 result and all 128 arena bytes.

Approval covers only the declared ordinary-memory, single-threaded, nonwrapping 128-byte domain with a separate valid stack and normal returns. Faults, concurrency, MMIO and other allocation domains remain excluded.
Corpus agreement and synthetic demos are not proof of whole-game behavior. Registry integration is not approved.
review.summary: Approve only the scoped source package with raw SHA-256 91ba11c8c3c8ac16985f757358ef78e6b90a6f2e41a4abd48313efef901f6f31. No behavioral discrepancy was found against the supplied instruction bytes within the frozen contracts. GuestMemory preserves little-endian aliasing and unaligned access without host pointer casts; bounded unsigned arithmetic and shifts have defined C++ semantics.

coordinator_correction: The review prose says 742 positive game cases. The actual reports establish 354 public + 288 held-out = 642. Raw review is preserved unchanged.
scope: Independent text-only review after automatic deterministic gates; current checkout integration evidence is recorded separately.
